answer_1.quote: We propose a multi-turn ESC system MultiESC ... to address the above issues. The system generates the next utterance x_t using an appropriate support strategy.
answer_1.outputs: generated supporter utterances (responses) for emotional support

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following metrics: perplexity (PPL), BLEU-1/2/3/4 (B-1/2/3/4), ROUGE-L (R-L), METEOR (MET), CIDEr.

answer_4.quote: We recruit four graduate students with linguistic or psychological background as annotators to chat with the models for human interactive evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare models by answering which one performs better (or tie) on fluency, empathy, identification, suggestion, and overall support effectiveness.
